methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: Personal Habits in Present Simple
content: Problem: Students can name objects and body parts, but struggle to string verbs together to describe their daily habits and the chronological flow of their day.

Solution: Week 6 introduces high-frequency action verbs related to self-care (wake up, wash, brush). By anchoring these verbs to times of day (morning, night), students learn to use the Present Simple naturally to describe real routines.

methodology.title: 2.4 Teacher Notes: Pull-Out Tasks & Communicative Task
content: Pull-out oral tasks (teacher does these with 1–2 students while class works):
S1 pull-out: Ask "What do you do in the morning?" Student mimes and says: "I wash my face. I brush my teeth."
S2 pull-out: Ask "What do you do at night?" Student: "I sleep at night."
S3 pull-out: Student reads S3 VC script aloud → teacher notes pronunciation errors (especially / ʃ / in wash, / ʃ / in brush) → recasts.
Materials needed: Print 2 copies of Card A and 2 copies of Card B.
Give Card A to Student A, Card B to Student B.
Students do not show their cards. They ask each other the target question to fill in the missing information.
Students produce complete sentences together to verify answers.

games.name: Vocab Slam
games.session_fit: All formats — best after vocab intro (P3) in any session
games.materials: Vocab flashcards W6: wake up, wash, brush, morning, eat
instructions: Round 1: Teacher calls a Vietnamese meaning — first student to say the English word AND use it correctly in a sentence wins the card.
Round 2: Reverse — teacher calls English word, student gives Vietnamese + memory trick.
Bonus round: Students chain all vocab words (wake up, wash, brush, morning, eat) into one connected story using sequence connectors from this week.
Team variant: 2 teams, 10 cards per round. Team with highest score wins.

games.name: Grammar Relay
games.session_fit: Best in Drill slot (Slot 2) or after P4/P6 in 3-session mode
games.materials: 10 sentence cards — 5 correct, 5 with errors based on: Present Simple (Habits & Routines with "I")
instructions: Grammar focus this week: Present Simple (Habits & Routines with "I").
Speed Read: Display sentence for 5 sec. Teams write C (correct) or E (error) on whiteboards simultaneously — no copying allowed.
Fix-It: For error sentences, team that corrects fastest AND explains the rule earns double points.
Build: Each team member adds 1 original sentence using the grammar target. The chain must be logically connected — each sentence must link to the previous.

games.name: Story Race
games.session_fit: All formats — best in final slot of the week (S3 / Slot 5 / Session B)
games.materials: Story starter card: theme "Daily Life — My Morning Routine"
instructions: Give each pair a story starter connected to this week's theme: "Daily Life — My Morning Routine".
Pair A adds 2 sentences — must include at least 2 vocab words from this week.
Pass to Pair B: they MUST correct any grammar mistake from Pair A first, then add 2 more sentences using different vocab words.
Final round: Each pair presents their story ending aloud. Class votes on most creative + most accurate (wake up, wash, brush, morning, eat usage). Teacher scores grammar precision.

chanting.title: Chanting — W6 (9 prompts)
chanting.script:
[W6.CHANT.1] Bright, colorful, 2D cartoon educational style, 4-second looping clip, white background, no real people: Animated sun rising + bold text "WAKE UP" pulses + Audio: "Wake up! Wake up! I wake up!"
[W6.CHANT.2] Bright, colorful, 2D cartoon educational style, 4-second looping clip, white background: Hands washing with water + bold "WASH" pulses on screen + Audio: "Wash! Wash! I wash my face!"
[W6.CHANT.3] Bright, colorful, 2D cartoon educational style, 4-second looping clip, white background: A toothbrush brushing teeth + bold "BRUSH" pulses on screen + Audio: "Brush! Brush! I brush my teeth!"

[W6.CHANT.5] Bright, colorful, 2D cartoon educational style, 4-second looping clip, white background: A bowl of cereal + bold "EAT" pulses on screen + Audio: "Eat! Eat! I eat breakfast!"
[W6.CHANT.6] Bright, colorful, 2D cartoon educational style, 4-second looping clip, white background: A backpack walking to school + bold "GO" pulses on screen + Audio: "Go! Go! I go to school!"
[W6.CHANT.7] Bright, colorful, 2D cartoon educational style, 4-second looping clip, white background: A sleepy moon + bold "SLEEP" pulses on screen + Audio: "Sleep! Sleep! I go to sleep!"
[W6.CHANT.8] Bright, colorful, 2D cartoon educational style, 4-second looping clip, white background: A dark sky with stars + bold "NIGHT" pulses on screen + Audio: "Night! Night! At night!"
[W6.CHANT.9] 6-second looping clip, clean white background, 2D cartoon educational style: The words Wake up, Eat, Sleep pop up rapidly in boxes + Audio: "My busy daily routine!"

listening_script.text: Hello! I am Max. I am a happy boy. I wake up early in the morning. I wash my face. My face is clean. I brush my teeth. My teeth are white. I eat my breakfast. I go to school. I love the morning! What do you do in the morning?

teacher_contents.in_class_speaking:
IN-CLASS SPEAKING ACTIVITIES — Session 1 (teacher-led)

Activity 1 — Pair Speaking (3–5 min, pairs):
  Student A: "What do you do in the morning?"
  Student B: "I wake up and I wash my face!"

Challenge Extension (L3 — for advanced / older students):
  [O] L3 — Older: Fill in the blank with 3 options (10 items)
  I _______________ up early. (wake / wash / brush)
  I _______________ my face. (wash / run / fly)
  I _______________ my teeth. (brush / wake / go)
  I eat breakfast in the _______________. (morning / night / jar)
  I _______________ to school. (go / eat / wash)
  My face _______________ clean. (is / are / am)
  My teeth _______________ white. (are / is / am)
  I _______________ my morning routine. (love / jump / brush)
  I have two _______________. (hands / head / nose)
  He _______________ a happy boy. (is / am / are)
  L4 — Sentence Expansion [ALL] (10 items)
teacher_contents.vc_answer_key: [1] everyone [2] to [3] new [4] talk [5] routine [6] wake [7] morning [8] wash [9] face [10] brush [11] teeth [12] eat [13] breakfast [14] drink [15] milk [16] go [17] school [18] love

listening_script.text: Hello! I am Luna. At night, I am very tired. I go home with my family. I eat a nice dinner. I wash my hands and my face. I brush my teeth. Then, I go to my bedroom. I sleep in my big bed. I have beautiful dreams every night.

teacher_contents.in_class_speaking:
IN-CLASS SPEAKING ACTIVITIES — Session 2 (teacher-led)

Activity 1 — Pair Speaking (3–5 min, pairs):
  Student A: "What do you do at night?"
  Student B: "I go home, I eat dinner, and I sleep!"
  Goal: Practice stringing evening routine actions together.

Challenge Extension (L3 — for advanced / older students):
  [O] L3 — Older: Fill in the blank with 3 options (10 items)
  I _______________ my dinner. (eat / sleep / fly)
  I _______________ home at night. (go / eat / wash)
  I _______________ in my bed. (sleep / read / run)
  I feel very _______________. (tired / jar / paper)
  The sky is dark at _______________. (night / morning / day)
  I wash my _______________. (hands / books / beds)
  I sleep in a big _______________. (bed / car / tree)
  I _______________ my teeth at night. (brush / jump / run)
  We _______________ a good team. (are / is / am)
  I have two _______________. (eyes / nose / head)
  L4 — Sentence Expansion [ALL] (10 items)
teacher_contents.vc_answer_key: [1] Welcome back to my [2] my night routine [3] feel very tired [4] with my nice family [5] wash my hands [6] brush my teeth again [7] my big bedroom [8] very soft bed

listening_script.text: Hello friends! I am Max. I have a busy day. In the morning, I wake up very early. I brush my teeth and wash my face. I eat a big breakfast. Then I go to school. At night, I feel so tired. I go home. I wash my dirty hands. I eat a nice dinner with my family. Finally, I go to sleep in my bed. I love my busy daily routine!

teacher_contents.in_class_speaking:
IN-CLASS SPEAKING ACTIVITIES — Session 3 (teacher-led)

Activity 1 — Pair Speaking (3–5 min, pairs):
  Student A: "What is your daily routine?"
  Student B: "I wake up in the morning, and I sleep at night!"
  Goal: Practice stringing the full sequence of a day.

Challenge Extension (L3 — for advanced / older students):
  [O] L3 — Older: Fill in the blank with 3 options (10 items)
  I _______________ up early. (wake / sleep / jump)
  I _______________ my face. (wash / eat / run)
  I _______________ my teeth. (brush / fly / swim)
  I _______________ a big breakfast. (eat / sleep / wash)
  I _______________ to school. (go / eat / brush)
  At _______________, I am tired. (night / morning / day)
  I go _______________. (home / tree / car)
  I _______________ my dinner. (eat / brush / wake)
  I go to _______________. (sleep / eat / wash)
  I have a busy _______________. (day / night / sky)
  L4 — Sentence Expansion [ALL] (10 items)
